# C4 Level 4 — Data Models

This folder contains the output from the `/data-models` skill.

## Contents (generated by agent)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `entity-relationships.md` | PostgreSQL DDL for all service databases, cross-service ERD (Mermaid), OCPP/OCPI field alignment notes |
| `entity-relationships.drawio` | draw.io ER diagram |
| `kafka-message-schemas.md` | JSON Schema (draft-07) for every Kafka topic message |
| `redis-key-schema.md` | Redis key patterns, TTLs, value types, owner services |

## Run `/data-models` to generate these files (requires `/approve c4-component` first).
